intro: The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie from CAVA delivers a wholesome twist on traditional desserts. Made with real oats, dried apricots, and natural honey, this 220-calorie treat offers a lighter finish to your Mediterranean meal. Available at [CAVA locations](/locations) nationwide, this artisan cookie combines nutritious ingredients with satisfying sweetness for a guilt-free indulgence.
priceCalories: Priced between $3.25 and $3.55 depending on location, the Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie contains 220 calories per serving. With 3g of protein, 34g of carbohydrates, and 9g of fat, it provides a balanced dessert option on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts). The price reflects the premium quality ingredients and artisan preparation.
whatMakesSpecial: This cookie stands out for its use of wholesome ingredients like almond flour and real dried apricots instead of refined sugars and artificial flavors. The honey provides natural sweetness while oats add hearty texture and fiber. Unlike mass-produced cookies, each Whisked! creation is carefully crafted to complement the Mediterranean philosophy found throughout the [full CAVA menu](/), emphasizing quality and nutrition.
nutritionFacts: Each Apricot Honey Oat Cookie delivers 220 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 3g protein, 34g carbohydrates, and 9g fat. The oats provide dietary fiber while almond flour adds healthy fats and protein. Eggs contribute additional protein, and honey offers natural sweetness without processed sugars. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed nutritional information.
whatsInside: The ingredient list features wholesome components: rolled oats form the base, dried apricots provide fruity sweetness, honey acts as a natural binder, almond flour adds nutty richness, and eggs help bind everything together. This simple, recognizable ingredient list avoids artificial preservatives and refined sugars. For ingredient concerns, visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for comprehensive details.
tasteLike: The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie offers a delightful balance of chewy oats and sweet apricot chunks with subtle honey notes. The almond flour provides a nutty undertone that complements the fruit beautifully. The texture is pleasantly chewy with slight crispness around the edges, creating a satisfying bite that feels both indulgent and wholesome without overwhelming sweetness.
customize: This dessert comes as a complete cookie without customization options. However, you can enhance your experience by pairing it with beverages from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). Consider ordering multiple desserts to share, or combine it with the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie or Chocolate Fudge Brownie for a varied dessert platter at your next gathering or meal.
pairsWell: The Apricot Honey Oat Cookie pairs wonderfully with hot coffee or tea to enhance its honey notes. It also complements the savory flavors from [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) items, providing a sweet contrast after Mediterranean spices. The fruity apricot works well following meals with [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus or tzatziki, cleansing your palate with natural sweetness.
healthyChoice: At 220 calories with wholesome ingredients like oats and almond flour, this cookie offers a more nutritious dessert choice compared to traditional options. The oats provide fiber for digestive health, while honey offers natural sweetness with trace minerals. The absence of refined sugars and artificial ingredients makes it a smarter indulgence for health-conscious diners seeking Mediterranean-inspired treats.
howToOrder: Order the Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie at any CAVA location by requesting it at checkout after building your bowl or pita. You can also add it through the CAVA mobile app or online ordering system. It appears in the desserts section alongside other sweet options. Ask your server to add it to your meal for a complete Mediterranean dining experience.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie at 140 calories and the Chocolate Fudge Brownie at 150 calories, the Apricot Honey Oat Cookie contains slightly more calories at 220 but offers unique fruity flavors and whole grain benefits. The Whisked! Salted Dark Chocolate Oat Cookie at 260 calories provides a chocolate alternative with similar oat-based texture and artisan quality.
whoShouldTry: This cookie appeals to health-conscious dessert lovers who appreciate wholesome ingredients and natural sweetness. Fans of Mediterranean cuisine will enjoy its alignment with CAVA's nutritional philosophy. Fruit and oat enthusiasts seeking alternatives to chocolate-based desserts should definitely try it. Those following the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) should verify current ingredient specifications before ordering.
worthTrying: The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie absolutely deserves a try for its unique flavor profile and quality ingredients. At $3.25 to $3.55, it represents excellent value for an artisan dessert made with premium components. The combination of apricots, honey, and oats creates a distinctive taste experience that stands out from typical restaurant desserts, making it a worthwhile finish to your CAVA meal.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie?
faqs.a: The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie contains 220 calories per serving, with 3g protein, 34g carbohydrates, and 9g fat. This makes it a moderate-calorie dessert option compared to other CAVA sweets.

faqs.q: What are the main ingredients in the Apricot Honey Oat Cookie?
faqs.a: The cookie is made with oats, dried apricot, honey, almond flour, and eggs. These wholesome ingredients provide natural sweetness and nutrition without artificial flavors or refined sugars.

faqs.q: How much does the Apricot Honey Oat Cookie cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: The Whisked! Apricot Honey Oat Cookie is priced between $3.25 and $3.55, depending on your location. This reflects the premium artisan quality and wholesome ingredients used in its preparation.

faqs.q: Is the Apricot Honey Oat Cookie gluten-free?
faqs.a: The cookie contains oats, which may not be suitable for those with celiac disease depending on processing. Check with your local CAVA or review the allergen menu for current gluten information and cross-contamination details.

faqs.q: How does this cookie compare to other CAVA desserts?
faqs.a: At 220 calories, it has more calories than the Greyston Blondie and Brownie but offers unique fruity flavors and whole grain benefits. It provides a non-chocolate alternative with natural sweetness from apricots and honey.
